title: Clean interface for mutual funds
text: Best app for direct mutual fund investments and SIP tracking. Very smooth UI.

title: Frequent logout and PIN issues
text: Every time I open the app after updating on iOS, it asks for OTP verification. Fix this biometric login bug.

title: Good app but need better F&O charts
text: Trading view charts sometimes lag during market open hours. Otherwise options chain is very easy to use.

title: Withdrawal delay to bank
text: Placed withdrawal on Monday morning but balance credited only after 48 hours. Support chat was unhelpful.

title: Super easy for beginners
text: Started my investing journey with Groww. Very transparent charges and no hidden fees.

title: KYC re-verification stuck
text: Re-KYC pending since last two weeks, account is frozen and I cannot execute SIP orders. Please resolve.

title: Fast UPI mandates
text: UPI mandate setup for autopay SIP is instantaneous. Love the dashboard simplicity.

title: Need dark mode on iPad
text: Good on iPhone, but iPad layout needs work and dark mode toggle is missing in profile settings.

title: Great mutual funds tracking
text: External mutual funds import through CAS is a great feature. Please add XIRR calculation for all folios.

title: Order execution freeze during expiry
text: App got stuck on Thursday expiry around 2:30 PM. Couldn't exit my position and incurred loss.
